definitions.rationale: Base equation defining the proof-local intVals embedding on the empty IntSeq constructor.
definitions.text: rule intVals(.IntSeq)                => .ValSeq

definitions.rationale: Recursive constructor equation defining intVals by preserving each integer head and embedding the tail.
definitions.text: rule intVals(iCons(I:Int, R:IntSeq)) => vCons(I, intVals(R))

definitions.rationale: Totalization equation defining intAt on an empty IntSeq for every index.
definitions.text: rule intAt(.IntSeq, _:Int) => 0

definitions.rationale: Zero-index equation defining intAt to return the head of a nonempty IntSeq.
definitions.text: rule intAt(iCons(I:Int, _:IntSeq), 0) => I

definitions.rationale: Positive-index recurrence defining intAt by consuming one sequence constructor and decrementing the index.
definitions.text:
rule intAt(iCons(_:Int, R:IntSeq), N:Int) => intAt(R, N -Int 1)
    requires N >Int 0

definitions.rationale: Negative-index totalization equation completing the proof-local definition of intAt.
definitions.text:
rule intAt(iCons(_:Int, _:IntSeq), N:Int) => 0
    requires N <Int 0

definitions.rationale: Invalid-index base equation defining thirdFrom as false outside strictly increasing in-range index configurations.
definitions.text:
rule thirdFrom(IS:IntSeq, I:Int, J:Int, K:Int) => false
    requires I <Int 0
      orBool J <=Int I
      orBool K <=Int J
      orBool I >=Int isLen(IS)
      orBool J >=Int isLen(IS)

definitions.rationale: Search-exhaustion base equation defining thirdFrom as false once the third index reaches the sequence length.
definitions.text:
rule thirdFrom(IS:IntSeq, I:Int, J:Int, K:Int) => false
    requires 0 <=Int I
      andBool I <Int J
      andBool J <Int K
      andBool J <Int isLen(IS)
      andBool K >=Int isLen(IS)

definitions.rationale: Recursive equation defining thirdFrom as the current three-value zero-sum test or the search at the next third index.
definitions.text:
rule thirdFrom(IS:IntSeq, I:Int, J:Int, K:Int)
    => ((intAt(IS, I) +Int intAt(IS, J) +Int intAt(IS, K))
          ==Int 0)
       orBool thirdFrom(IS, I, J, K +Int 1)
    requires 0 <=Int I
      andBool I <Int J
      andBool J <Int K
      andBool K <Int isLen(IS)

definitions.rationale: Invalid-index base equation defining pairFrom as false outside its increasing-index search domain.
definitions.text:
rule pairFrom(IS:IntSeq, I:Int, J:Int) => false
    requires I <Int 0
      orBool J <=Int I
      orBool I >=Int isLen(IS)

definitions.rationale: Search-exhaustion base equation defining pairFrom as false after the second index reaches the sequence length.
definitions.text:
rule pairFrom(IS:IntSeq, I:Int, J:Int) => false
    requires 0 <=Int I
      andBool I <Int J
      andBool J >=Int isLen(IS)

definitions.rationale: Recursive equation defining pairFrom by searching third indices for the current second index and then advancing that second index.
definitions.text:
rule pairFrom(IS:IntSeq, I:Int, J:Int)
    => thirdFrom(IS, I, J, J +Int 1)
       orBool pairFrom(IS, I, J +Int 1)
    requires 0 <=Int I
      andBool I <Int J
      andBool J <Int isLen(IS)

definitions.rationale: Negative-index base equation defining tripleFrom as false outside its intended starting-index domain.
definitions.text:
rule tripleFrom(_:IntSeq, I:Int) => false
    requires I <Int 0

definitions.rationale: Search-exhaustion base equation defining tripleFrom as false when the first index reaches the sequence length.
definitions.text:
rule tripleFrom(IS:IntSeq, I:Int) => false
    requires I >=Int isLen(IS)

definitions.rationale: Recursive equation defining tripleFrom by searching later pairs for the current first index and then advancing that index.
definitions.text:
rule tripleFrom(IS:IntSeq, I:Int)
    => pairFrom(IS, I, I +Int 1)
       orBool tripleFrom(IS, I +Int 1)
    requires 0 <=Int I andBool I <Int isLen(IS)

definitions.rationale: Nullary syntax equation defining the named inner-loop condition term.
definitions.text:
rule innerCond() =>
    Compare(
      Name("k"),
      CmpOp("<", Call(Name("len"), (Name("l"), .Exprs))))

definitions.rationale: Nullary syntax equation defining the named inner-loop body as the exact translated statement sequence.
definitions.text:
rule innerBody() =>
    If(
      Compare(
        BinOp(
          "+",
          BinOp(
            "+",
            Subscript(Name("l"), Name("i")),
            Subscript(Name("l"), Name("j"))),
          Subscript(Name("l"), Name("k"))),
        CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
      Assign(Name("found"), Bool(true)) .Stmts,
      .Stmts)
    AugAssign(Name("k"), "+", Int(1))
    .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Nullary syntax equation defining the named middle-loop condition term.
definitions.text:
rule middleCond() =>
    Compare(
      Name("j"),
      CmpOp("<", Call(Name("len"), (Name("l"), .Exprs))))

definitions.rationale: Nullary syntax equation defining the named middle-loop body and its nested inner-loop term.
definitions.text:
rule middleBody() =>
    Assign(Name("k"), BinOp("+", Name("j"), Int(1)))
    While(innerCond(), innerBody())
    Assign(Name("k"), Int(0))
    AugAssign(Name("j"), "+", Int(1))
    .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Nullary syntax equation defining the named outer-loop condition term.
definitions.text:
rule outerCond() =>
    Compare(
      Name("i"),
      CmpOp("<", Call(Name("len"), (Name("l"), .Exprs))))

definitions.rationale: Nullary syntax equation defining the named outer-loop body and its nested middle-loop term.
definitions.text:
rule outerBody() =>
    Assign(Name("j"), BinOp("+", Name("i"), Int(1)))
    While(middleCond(), middleBody())
    Assign(Name("j"), Int(0))
    AugAssign(Name("i"), "+", Int(1))
    .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Nullary syntax equation defining the complete translated program body from initialization through return.
definitions.text:
rule programBody() =>
    Assign(Name("found"), Bool(false))
    Assign(Name("i"), Int(0))
    Assign(Name("j"), Int(0))
    Assign(Name("k"), Int(0))
    While(outerCond(), outerBody())
    Return(Name("found"))
    .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Equation defining the named closure value from its parameter list, programBody term, and defining environment.
definitions.text:
rule triplesClosure() =>
    closureVal(("l", .ParamNames), programBody(), 0)

definitions.rationale: Equation defining the exact global solution binding map for the public entry-point closure.
definitions.text:
rule solutionBindings() =>
    "triples_sum_to_zero" |-> triplesClosure()

Additional guarded simplification fact relating frozen-semantics valSeqAt to proof-local intAt; Stage 1 contains no prior exact proof in a module omitting this rule.
source_rules.text:
rule valSeqAt(intVals(IS:IntSeq), I:Int) => intAt(IS, I)
    requires 0 <=Int I andBool I <Int isLen(IS)
    [simplification]
